title: Two-Sided Nearest Neighbors: An adaptive and minimax optimal procedure for matrix completion
abstract: arXiv:2411.12965v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Nearest neighbor (NN) algorithms have been extensively used for missing data problems in recommender systems and sequential decision-making systems. Prior theoretical analysis has established favorable guarantees for NN when the underlying data is sufficiently smooth and the missingness probabilities are lower bounded. Here we analyze NN with non-smooth non-linear functions with vast amounts of missingness. In particular, we consider matrix completion settings where the entries of the underlying matrix follow a latent non-linear factor model, with the non-linearity belonging to a \Holder function class that is less smooth than Lipschitz. translated_title: 双侧最近邻：一种自适应且极小极大最优的矩阵补全方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2411.12965v3 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：最近邻（NN）算法已广泛用于推荐系统和序贯决策系统中的缺失数据问题。先前的理论分析表明，当底层数据足够平滑且缺失概率有下界时，NN具有有利的保证。在此，我们分析NN在非平滑非线性函数和大量缺失情况下的表现。特别地，我们考虑矩阵补全设置，其中底层矩阵的条目遵循潜在非线性因子模型，非线性属于比Lipschitz更不光滑的Holder函数类。我们的结果为合适的双侧NN建立了以下有利性质：（1）NN的均方误差（MSE）自适应于非线性的光滑度，（2）在一定的正则条件下，NN的误差率与具备知识的神谕获得的速率相匹配。
tldr: 本文提出双侧最近邻方法，在矩阵补全中适应非光滑非线性结构，实现自适应且极小极大最优的误差率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-sided nearest neighbor method that adapts to non-smooth nonlinear structures in matrix completion, achieving adaptive and minimax optimal error rates.
